scripts.lint: pnpm typecheck && pnpm typecheck:hosted && pnpm check:boundaries && pnpm check:determinism
scripts.test: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:hosted && pnpm test:contract && pnpm test:determinism && pnpm test:persistence && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:scale
scripts.test:unit: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --env-file-if-exists=.env.development node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --exclude src/simulation/scenarios/** --exclude src/**/*.integration.test.ts --exclude src/simulation/engine/advance.test.ts --exclude src/simulation/engine/scaleBenchmark.test.ts --exclude src/simulation/serialization/** --exclude src/persistence/** --exclude src/hosted/** --exclude src/worker/client.contract.test.ts
scripts.test:hosted: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --env-file-if-exists=.env.development node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run src/hosted --exclude src/hosted/postgres.integration.test.ts --exclude src/hosted/apiContract.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:contract: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --env-file-if-exists=.env.development node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run src/simulation/scenarios src/simulation/engine/advance.test.ts src/hosted/apiContract.test.ts src/worker/client.contract.test.ts --exclude src/simulation/scenarios/milestone4Determinism.test.ts --exclude src/simulation/scenarios/milestone70Integration.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:e2e:critical: node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --project=chromium && node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --project=firefox --project=webkit --grep "@critical"
